title: Which AI Is Better? 🖥️ WEBSITE EDITION
description:
I gave two of the most popular AI website builders the exact same prompt:

Build a landing page for Midjourney's crazy new full-body scanner product.

Both generated a great concept and turned out way better than I expected, but they had different workflows. Claude design generated a great concept, but @Framer is made for iterating, refining, and shipping a production-ready website all in 1 platform.

Let me know in the comment which site you liked better.

And check out www.Framer.com to build your own site today.

#FramerPartner #vibecoding #webdesign #ai #aiagents
